title: CFA Program Level II review
audience: a finance graduate or career changer preparing for the CFA Program exams and a career in investment analysis
purpose: Review the CFA Program Level II body of knowledge, which centers on asset valuation, through vignette-based item sets: ethics, quantitative methods, economics, financial statement analysis, corporate issuers, equity valuation, fixed income, derivatives, alternative investments and portfolio management.
primary_reading: CFA Institute: CFA Program overview and exam information

weeks.2: Quantitative methods: regression and time series
weeks.4: Financial statement analysis: intercorporate investments and pensions
weeks.5: Financial statement analysis: multinationals and quality
weeks.7: Equity valuation I: DDM and free cash flow
weeks.8: Equity valuation II: multiples and residual income
weeks.9: Fixed income: term structure, credit and options

blocks.deliverable: Work a timed FSA item set.
Analyze the quality of reported earnings in a vignette.
Week 7 midterm; a timed set of mixed vignettes.
Value a callable bond and a swap in vignettes.
Take a full-length timed practice exam.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Valuation case set: write and solve your own vignette with four item-set questions on one company, take two full-length timed practice exams of original item sets, and keep an error log with a targeted review plan.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
